title: Self-Tor termwise projection homology invertible arrow
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-self-tor-projection-homology-termwise, there exists an invertible arrow from the degree-k homology of the derived tensor square of the pushed-forward structure sheaf to the pushforward of the degree-k homology of the termwise tensor pullback.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.22.1; projection formula, representative comparison, and exact pushforward

proof.text: Compute the derived tensor square with the K-flat single tensor representative and identify the ordinary total tensor complex with termwise pullback followed by pushforward.

Apply derived homology to the localized complex isomorphism, compose homologyFunctorFactors, and commute homology with the existing exact closed module pushforward theorem. Return the hom of the composite isomorphism with its IsIso instance.

based_on.place: K-flat tensor computation followed by ordinary closed-immersion projection and exact pushforward

theorem exists_selfTor_projection_homology_termwise_arrow
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (a : P ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := Y.sheaf) a)
    (k : ℤ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    ∃ f : ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B)) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T.homology k), IsIso f
